name: H R Analytics App
prompt: HR analytics page with employee distribution by department and retention metrics.

thought_process.interpretation: An HR Operations dashboard designed for executives and HR managers to monitor organizational health. I selected the 'Executive Summary' grid layout to prioritize high-level KPIs like headcount and attrition, followed by visualizations for department distribution and retention trends. The app includes a fully functional employee directory for row-level detail.
assumed_from_scratch: Employee record generation logic with weighted distributions for departments
Retention rate trend calculation for historical time-series data
Tab-based navigation state with persistent filters
thought_process.skill_suggestions: A dedicated 'retention_analytics' skill for standardizing cohort analysis and attrition forecasting (voluntary vs involuntary) would be beneficial for future HR-specific requests.
